title: Value your Normal Summon
body: You get one Normal Summon/Set per turn. Plan combos so the Normal Summon is a starter or extender, not a dead body.

title: Chain link priority
body: Fast effects (Quick Effects, Traps) can respond. Know when you can respond before the opponent continues their sequence.

title: Track resources, not just boards
body: A flashy board that empties hand/GY advantage can lose to a single break. Count follow-up for next turn.

title: Play to the win condition
body: Decide if you are racing, grinding, or controlling. Wrong plan for the matchup loses even with 'correct' individual plays.

title: Ash Blossom timing
body: Ash stops add/special/send from deck effects. Hold it for the search that completes their engine.

title: Mental sideboarding (BO1)
body: Even in BO1, think sideboard ideas: which of your cards are dead, which of theirs you must respect first game.
